caption: The video captures an elevated aerial view over a rural valley bathed in low sunlight. A patchwork of bright green fields fills the lower half, anchored by a single small white house and a vertical dirt road at the left. A dense dark-green tree grove spreads across the foreground. A thick, flat-topped bank of white fog sits in the middle distance, concealing the valley floor beneath a silhouetted mountain ridge, while a partly cloudy sky and a bright glare from the left edge hang above. The framing drifts slowly to the left, sliding the foreground house, road and tree grove toward the left edge and slightly downward. The distant ridge and fog bank drift left along with the nearer elements, the whole view sliding gradually across the frame. The upper edge of the fog and the sky clouds change only subtly and continuously, with no abrupt onset or clearing. The sun glare and overall lighting remain persistent, and no object enters, leaves, or completes an action.
